observations: Black painted metal bunk bed frame.
Two-tier structure with a top and bottom bunk.
Integrated ladder on the side of the frame.
Safety guard rails present on the top bunk.
Metal slat base for supporting mattresses on both levels.
The frame appears to be made of square and circular hollow sections.
Photographed in an outdoor commercial area in front of a shop.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a two-tier metal bed frame.

risks.risk: Structural instability or excessive wobbling when in use.
risks.proof: A video clip of the frame being shaken vigorously at the top rail.

risks.risk: Missing assembly hardware (bolts, nuts, or connectors).
risks.proof: A photo of all connection points showing bolts are present and tight.

risks.risk: Hidden rust or corrosion under the black paint, especially at joints.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the welding joints and the underside of the slats.
risks.if_unproven: as having surface rust and poor weld quality

proof_requests: Video of the bed being shaken to test stability.
Close-up photos of all four corner joints and bolt locations.
Dimensions of the bed (length and width) to confirm mattress size compatibility.
response.reason: The item is a standard metal bunk bed frame clearly visible in the photo. While structural integrity and completeness of hardware are unverified, it can be priced at the worst-case scenario for a generic used metal frame.
